body.name: Production and test environments separated
body.description: Test activity cannot reach production data.
body.detail: Running in demo mode: the tamper drill is enabled, so this instance must be treated as non-production.
observations: TRACEX_DEMO_MODE=true permits /integrity/drill to mutate a stored record. Correct for a demonstration, unacceptable for an instance holding real evidence.
Set TRACEX_DEMO_MODE=false in production; the drill then refuses.
